description: Overweight 21y female with PCOS, fat-loss goal, lacto-vegetarian. PCOS bumps protein (2.1 g/kg) and shifts fats up; the plan must stay in a calorie deficit while favouring low-GI / high-fibre dishes. This is a deliberately HARD protein case: a veg mess on a deficit cannot reach the full protein target from food alone, so the plan should max mess protein and lean on the small canteen budget (sprouts/milk) for the rest — and still flag any remaining gap rather than failing.
